design: Post-hoc sensitivity execution plan frozen after R7.1 results and scientific-content review; not prospective experiment registration

levels.interpretation: same previously used hypothetical fixed-fMCP levels; not measured range, calibrated microbial distribution, external demonstration offsets or complete-NASEM sensitivity

population: All 96 latest coverage/measurement policy-cell records; coverage18 cells x2 rules, measurement6 cells x10 rules; 20000 original saved states per record
invariants: fixed all other row and domain definitions
no draw, retrain, reseed, selection or original-file write
transformation: NEL_margin(m) = saved_margin - 0.00218724 * saved_actual_supplied_DM * 16.5 * (m - 1); mathematically equivalent expression uses (16.5*m - 16.5) for inherited numerical implementation
nonenergy_proof: fMCP enters DE and urinary energy affinely; no fMCP argument in nonenergy/domain/support predicates; positive finite hypothetical levels cannot change structural undefined causes
risk: known_violation OR unknown; event unknown excludes known violations

rates_error_family.method: One-sided exact Clopper-Pearson upper used only as post-hoc diagnostic; separately declared family with old numerical budget, not fresh validation/certification, measured robustness or original experiment certification
rates_error_family.classification: same thresholds applied to each new-family upper; baseline original upper also retained and identity checked

pair_error_family.method: Descriptive paired counts and empirical difference only; no new paired interval, significance classification or confidence family

pairs: 18 coverage fullQ2 vsQ3; each of6measurement cells: Q2ideal vsQ3ideal and at each .1/.5 noise Q3UA vsraw, Q3UA vsmean, Q3mean vsraw, Q2UA vsQ3UA; five levels, no cross-cell or cross-protocol pairs
severity_metrics: NEL positive-deficit occurrence among defined and classified energy violation among total
normalized mean and P95 among original-tolerance classified violations
zero-inclusive P95 and largest ceil5pct mean with rescaled-mean identity diagnostic
unknown row count and event unknown count separately
validation: All96 baseline exact saved labels and aggregate risk upper match; canonical evaluate_reference spot validation at all5levels on deterministic33even indices plus10nearest-to-energy-threshold perlevel plus all energy undefined states plus actualDM extrema (union perpolicy); compare energy margins, energy defined/violated and event masks; original input SHA before and after; all labels within1e-10 of energy threshold covered by validation; no sampling
outputs: safe normalized aggregateCSV; private margin/error/hash validation; portable standalone script referencing unmodified extracted R7core; no private exact animal, recipe or target magnitudes in safe tables

revision_before_computation.reason: Root clarified inferential scope: diagnostic CP upper bounds only, all pairs descriptive; no new certificate or significance claim
